**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation or no-hire obligation on Bluefly. I checked both planner candidates and ran document-wide searches for the detection triggers ("solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce") — no hiring restriction appears anywhere:

- **§ 14.8 Personnel** covers only each party's supervision/direction of its own personnel, IBM's right to assign its personnel, and IBM's use of subcontractors.
- **§ 14.16 Freedom of Action** cuts the other way in our favour, confirming each party may enter into similar agreements with others.

This sits at the **preferred position** (no non-solicit on Customer), better than the mutual 12-month fallback, so there is nothing to narrow and no clause to add — proposing one would only introduce a restriction on us that IBM has not asked for.
